description: Set how a project keeps its statuses in step with its own Jira: the direction and the pairs of statuses. Either left out keeps what is there. Moves on either side go through that side's own workflow and are never forced: a move one refuses is left undone and said on the issue (get_jira_link's 'sync'). A move made here because Jira moved is made in YOUR name from now on — whoever saves this is whom it acts for — and Jira's history names the project token's owner. Switching it on moves nothing by itself: the next change on either side does. Both sides moved before the two were compared: neither is moved, and the issue says so. The site's webhook (quicker than the five-minute poll) is set up on the screen, since its address is a secret. For whoever administers the project; needs the connection switched on, with its token.

pairs.description: The pairs, here=there, separated by ';' or new lines: 'To Do=To Do; In Progress=In Progress; Done=Done'. A status may appear in several pairs; the first one in order is where a move goes. An empty string clears them. Omit to keep.

name: set_jira_sync
title: Set Jira sync
